items.abstract: <jats:p>The following document was adopted by the States Parties to the Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in Europe on the scope and parameters of the process commissioned in paragraph 19 of the Final Document of the First CFE Treaty Review Conference. The meeting of the States Parties to the CFE Treaty took place in Lisbon, Portugal.</jats:p>
title: States Parties to CFE Agree to Adapt Treaty to New Security Landscape
